items.title: Three Attacks, Zero Exploits in Microsoft 365
items.description: Learn how three real-world attacks turn ordinary user actions into full Microsoft 365 compromise, and what to fix before they land in your inbox.

items.title: Huntress EU Data Hosting: What Phase 1 Means
items.description: Huntress has kicked off EU data hosting. See what’s stored in Frankfurt in Phase 1, what stays in the US, and what’s planned for Phase 2.

items.title: A Buffet of ClickFix: Lures, Infrastructure & Payloads
items.description: Tradecraft Tuesday recap: convincing ClickFix lures, the infrastructure behind fake verification pages, varied payloads, and how to stop the paste.

items.title: Why Resilience Has to Come First
items.description: Recent outages at Microsoft, the FAA and major banks show why recovery planning matters more than blame. Learn how to define downtime, test alternatives and keep the business running.

items.title: Handling the NIST 800-171 Rev 3 Transition
items.description: Learn how defense contractors can navigate the transition from NIST SP 800-171 Revision 2 to Revision 3 with a practical four-step approach for CMMC compliance.

items.title: Detecting Timeroasting the Hard Way
items.description: Timeroasting leaves no authentication log, but it is not invisible. I reverse MS-SNTP's two authenticator forms to build detection that packet size cannot fool.

items.title: RMM Alerts at 2 AM: An MSP and SOC Incident Response Story
items.description: One compromised account, two rogue ScreenConnect deployments, and $3M in downtime. See how TruePath IT and the Huntress SOC handled RMM alerts at 2am.

items.title: What Business Email Compromise (BEC) Looks Like & How to Catch It
items.description: BEC hides in the vendor and billing threads you already trust. See how a Huntress team caught one, and the inbox rules and signs to watch for.

items.title: Huntress Delivers 24/7 Response for Microsoft Defender Incidents Across Endpoints and Microsoft 365
items.description: The Huntress Agentic Security Platform now sees incidents from Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, and Entra ID Protection. The new data already helped uncover a token-replay campaign that hit 97 accounts at 79 organizations.

items.title: CVE-2026-84869 in ScreenConnect Exploited to Run Malicious Files on MSP Technician Accounts
items.description: Huntress confirmed CVE-2026-84869 exploitation against MSP technicians via ScreenConnect. See the attack chain, IOCs, and how to protect your team.

items.title: New Huntress Security Insights Report & Reporting Center
items.description: Meet the redesigned Huntress Security Insights Report (formerly known as Threat Report), a one-page summary in an updated reporting center.

items.title: The AI Arena: Huntress CTF 2026 Retro
items.description: Explore Huntress CTF 2026, where competitors tackled real-world cybersecurity challenges and tested how AI can support human-led problem-solving.

items.title: Attackers use Crypto Exchange Names to Disguise Unauthorized Sessions on 100+ ScreenConnect Servers
items.description: Fake crypto exchange sessions are showing up on ScreenConnect servers and could be bait for technicians. See what Huntress found and what to do.

items.title: GeoVision Camera Software Abused to Deploy XMRig Cryptominer
items.description: Attackers abused publicly exposed GeoVision camera software at 13 organizations, tried to disable Defender, and deployed XMRig. Get the IoCs and next steps.

items.title: Crafty Microsoft Teams Booking Flow Disguises Device Code Phishing
items.description: Threat actors used a convincing Microsoft Teams meeting-booking lure to conceal device code phishing and trick victims into authorizing attacker access.

items.title: SCKit Worm Installs Rogue ScreenConnect Clients and Session Cookie Relays Across Hundreds of Endpoints
items.description: Attackers are using cloud-hosted and on-premise ScreenConnect panels to install rogue clients on hundreds of managed endpoints.

items.title: Beyond the clipboard: The evolving tradecraft of ClickFix
items.description: ClickFix techniques are evolving. Huntress breaks down four attack chains: lateral movement, hidden PNG payloads, Node.js RATs and cache seeing.

items.title: N-able Disables Cloud Services Following Disclosure of "Able2Shell" Exploit Chains
items.description: UPDATE: N-able took N-central offline after 33 critical flaws were disclosed, including chains enabling remote code execution and privilege escalation.

items.title: Inside an AhsayCBS Intrusion: Hidden Webshells, a CryptoMiner, and a C2 Implant
items.description: Follow-up on AhsayCBS intrusion: new webshells, a second miner, and a host-bound Python implant found on exploited backup servers.

items.title: Sasha Roshan Takes Security Education Beyond the Demo
items.description: Meet Sasha Roshan, Senior Sales Engineer at Huntress, a passionate advocate for cybersecurity. See how he makes a difference every day.
